scientific_integrity: Self-contained algebraic determinant proof and direct finite-matrix numerical checks. Existing Hadamard-pair results are explicitly credited. No independent audit or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-depth determinant and optimizer apply only to full square finite two-digit Cantor evaluation matrices with integer base-digit frequency steps, not arbitrary real frequency sets, redundant frames, or the infinite Cantor measure. Singular-value bounds are not claimed sharp.
title: Exact Fourier volume and the parity barrier in binary Cantor digit towers
